primary_repair_failure_rca.label: PATCH_APPLICATION_UNSAFE_DIFF_FALSE_POSITIVE
primary_repair_failure_rca.finding: The current PatchApplier scans the generated unified diff before writing. Its absolute-path alternative [a-z]:[\\/] also matches the s:/ substring inside https://. The URL is present in the changed s1 configuration diff context, so the safe reference edit is rejected as unsafe_diff before any file write or Maven run.

primary_repair_failure_rca.evidence_limit: The M7E-2A e2e artifact keeps the s1 edit count and stage metrics but does not keep its file, line range, old text, new text, or PatchApplier rejection detail; no s1 patch.diff exists. The failure mechanism is therefore directly reproduced on the canonical s1 reference edit, while exact historical payload identity is not provable.

diagnosis_metric.rca: All six cases completed with matching diagnosis status and category, hit at least one expected file, hit every evidence target, and had zero rejected evidence. Each nevertheless failed the deterministic case_pass rule because root_cause_keyword_coverage was below the fixed 0.66 threshold: s1 0.6, s2 0.4, s3 0.5, s4 0.6, s5 0.3333, s6 0.2.
diagnosis_metric.evaluator_contract: The diagnosis benchmark is an independent observational quality metric. It is not a prerequisite enforced by the repair-success predicate in the current runner.
